Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a large left-sided mass that obscures the left heart border (positive silhouette sign with the heart, implying anterior location) but preserves the contour of the left hemidiaphragm (negative silhouette sign), and causes contralateral tracheal deviation; these findings are characteristic of an anterior mediastinal tumor such as a yolk sac tumour.
